title: A reviewer approves only through its submit_review verdict: words that say APPROVED without the verdict, reminded and still unsent, or a verdict that does not approve, send the work back with the reviewer's words as feedback; only an approving verdict ends the loop approved
notes: Python: tests/orchestration/test_loop_strategy.py TestReviewVerdict. orchestration/strategies/_loop_verdict.py SUBMIT_REVIEW, read_review; loop.py _review, _review_ended. The reviewer is reminded three times (max_result_retries), then its last words are its feedback, not approved. The verdict tool is declared in the review's task only.
